arguments.summary: Lateral movement detected originating from compromised workstation WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), attributed to user jsmith. Attacker used phishing-derived credentials to execute a malicious PowerShell payload, deploying Cobalt Strike beacon via rundll32. Lateral movement to file server FS-CORP-02 (10.0.2.45) was performed using pass-the-hash with domain admin hash. A malicious scheduled task was created for persistence. Immediate containment actions included blocking C2 IP, resetting domain admin credentials, scanning endpoints, and hardening the compromised host.

timeline.description: Suspicious encoded PowerShell launched from Outlook process.
rundll32.exe loaded unsigned beacon.dll from Temp directory.
IDS alerted on Cobalt Strike C2 beacon (198.51.100.23:443).
Lateral movement via SMB to FS-CORP-02 (10.0.2.45) using da_jsmith hash.
SIEM alert triggered for lateral movement chain (INC-AP14-V4).
Firewall rule deployed to block outbound traffic to 198.51.100.23.
Domain admin account 'da_jsmith' credentials reset and MFA re-enrolled.
Full EPP scan on WS-FIN-042 detected and quarantined malicious payload.
Ansible playbook applied hardening controls to WS-FIN-042.
